query: Our Navision is really slow today, especially when posting sales orders. Can you check the SQL server SQLSRV01, database NAV_PROD?
expected_behavior: Runs Invoke-NavSqlPerfTriage.ps1 against SQLSRV01/NAV_PROD (prefers -OutFile for a full snapshot)
Interprets findings through the NAV lens: maps read-heavy statements to C/AL key/filter mismatches and checks blocking/deadlocks on posting tables
Leads with the 2-4 findings that matter and names any failed/skipped sections instead of implying full coverage

query: Users are stuck in NAV right now - everything is frozen.
expected_behavior: Runs a live-focused subset (-Sections blocking,deadlocks,waits) rather than a full snapshot
Identifies the head blocker (session, login, host, statement) from the blocking section
Explains that an open Classic-client transaction is a user/process problem, not an index problem, when the head blocker is an idle cursor

query: The missing-index DMV suggests an index on our item ledger table. Should I just create it in SSMS?
expected_behavior: Advises against raw CREATE INDEX as the primary fix because NAV 2009 owns indexes via table keys and SIFT views
Recommends translating the suggestion into a NAV key in C/SIDE (with matching SETCURRENTKEY in code)
Notes that an out-of-band SQL index is acceptable only as a labelled stopgap that is lost on key/company changes
